title: Permission Drift
subtitle: Harden a Linux workspace that drifted away from least privilege
summary: A reporting workstation accumulated unsafe file modes: a world-writable SSH directory, a readable private key and a world-writable report. Fix the actual files and document the audit.
scenario: Northwind Freight provisions this workspace for a reporting contractor. A pre-handover check found file modes that would let any local process read or alter secrets. Your job is to correct the real filesystem permissions and produce a short audit record.
learningObjectives: Audit file modes with stat and find
Apply owner-only permissions to sensitive files
Document permission findings and their risk
authorizedScope: Only this training workspace. The key material is synthetic and unusable outside the session.
riskSummary: Over-permissive modes allow credential theft and tampering by other local users or compromised processes. World-writable files also undermine audit integrity.
remediation: Use 0700 for ~/.ssh and 0600 for private keys and credential files, remove world-writable bits, and enforce configuration through provisioning rather than manual fixes.
conclusion: You restored least privilege across the workspace, including SSH material and a live credential file, and documented the drift so provisioning can be corrected.

objectives.title: Lock down SSH and credentials
objectives.description: Set ~/.ssh to 0700, the private key to 0600 and ~/.config/portal/credentials to 0600. The live check inspects the actual modes.

objectives.title: Eliminate world-writable files and document the audit
objectives.description: Remove world-writable permissions from the report file (and any other offending entry), then write evidence/permissions.json listing at least three issues and their corrected modes.

criteria: audit lists at least three issues

hints.text: `find ~ -perm -0002 -type f` finds world-writable files. `chmod o-w <file>` fixes one.

walkthrough.title: Inventory the modes
walkthrough.body: List the sensitive paths and their current modes.

walkthrough.title: Fix the modes
walkthrough.body: Apply owner-only permissions and remove the world-writable bit.

walkthrough.title: Document the audit
walkthrough.body: Record at least three issues with before/after modes, then run both objective checks.
walkthrough.snippet: jq -n '{issues:[{path:"~/.ssh",before:"0777",after:"0700"},{path:"~/.ssh/id_ed25519",before:"0644",after:"0600"},{path:"~/.config/portal/credentials",before:"0644",after:"0600"}],notes:"Provisioning drift exposed key material and allowed tampering"}' > ~/evidence/permissions.json
